title: People canvas-chip rewrite (behind a flag)
description: Replace each chip's CTkFrame + 2 CTkButton + CTkProgressBar (~10 Tk widgets, ~9 ms) with ONE tk.Canvas modeled on SlotWidget (~0.5 ms). Labels are already pre-rendered PIL images; drag/shift-wheel/_slot_ref tagging port directly. Kills the remaining per-widget floor (first panel <200 ms cold, prewarm ~2 s).
